## Mission

The Animal Health Econometrics group resumed its activity this year. Its work is currently carried by internal and external researchers, including a PhD project hosted at the Roslin Institute, University of Edinburgh.

Scope: quantitative analysis of the economic impact of animal diseases and of the interplay between animal health, trade and policy, building on WOAH and partner data.

## Research directions 

::: {.features}
::: {.feature}
#### Burden of disease
Methods and estimates of the economic losses caused by animal diseases.
:::
::: {.feature}
#### Trade and animal health
How disease events and status changes affect trade flows.
:::
::: {.feature}
#### Value of surveillance
Evidence on the return of investments in Veterinary Services and surveillance.
:::
:::
